anchors.event_window: US earnings, before market open tomorrow
anchors.refresh_note: Stage 2 spot ($23.66) and implied move (10.65%) as of 2026-09-04 were refreshed same-day (2026-09-08, ~15:53 UTC / 11:53 EDT, the day before tomorrow's BMO print) via stockanalysis.com and optionslam.com. Spot moved from $23.66 to $23.09; the 10.65% implied move was independently reconfirmed unchanged at the nearest weekly expiry.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Implied 10.65% modestly rich vs 7.59% mean-abs/6.52% median. Center realised ~7-9%. Direction is the harder half; skew favours the downside tail after a +23% run since the June low.
key_drivers: June guide cut (FY26 sales to $13.40-13.55B) reset the bar, but stock has since taken the relief back, +15% in a month -- no cushion left from lowered numbers
Metric that matters is FY26 sales guide + active-customer adds; consensus revenue $3.32B sits in the upper half of the $3.30-3.33B guide, so a low-end print is a headline miss
Known pre-announced margin headwind: Q2 gross margin guided to contract y/y on lapping MAP pricing benefits and a fuel surcharge
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Squeeze-higher case is real: short interest rebuilding (~9.6% of float), stock far below ~$30 avg target even after cuts, profitability has beaten every quarter -- a mid-range print with FY guide reaffirmed could gap up 8-12% on relief.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Could not source clean 90-day revision breadth or Q2 FCF/gross-margin consensus.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: 10.65% implied is rich; IV/HV ~1.6x. Expect ~7-9% realised. Direction not priced: skew pays for downside (puts bid) while volume flow is call-heavy -- a crowded, one-sided setup after a run-up.
key_drivers: Skew vs flow disagreement: 30-day put IV above call IV while call volume dominates -- momentum longs buying the bounce while the surface pays up for downside protection
Run-up is the trade: +18.4% in 30 days off a 52-week low, already fading into event eve; 38.5x P/E vs 19.2x specialty-retail median leaves no cushion
No squeeze fuel in the borrow: shorts rebuilt but cost-to-borrow near-zero, availability loose -- discretionary shorts, not trapped
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Reset-bar squeeze is live: 9.6% of free float short, rebuilt only in the last week; an in-line quarter with FY26 guide merely reaffirmed hands recent shorts nothing and calls are already bid.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No IV rank/percentile, term structure, or strike-level OI sourced; short-interest figures conflict across vendors.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Expect realised ~6-8%, inside the 10.65% implied. Directionally lean down; move size looks over-priced.
key_drivers: Crowd leans bullish into a stock that already pre-ran the print (+15% in 30 days) on sell-side framing rather than new data -- the setup to fade, not follow
Sell-side crowded long with fading conviction: 0% Sell ratings but targets being cut on the way in (Morgan Stanley, Mizuho, Rosenblatt initiating Neutral)
Retail interest real but thin, event-driven not a pump -- no coordinated promotion, meaning no retail bid to absorb a disappointment
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Bull case is margin not demand and Chewy has a strong EBITDA-beat record; if they beat EBITDA and merely reaffirm the already-lowered guide, a discretionary 9.6%-of-float short base plus 0%-Sell sell-side gives a fast double-digit squeeze off a depressed base.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No current web-traffic/app-rank data; short interest and analyst-target figures single-sourced.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Base-rate expected absolute move ~7-9%; distribution bimodal (three prints in 1-2%, three in 11-17%), nothing in between. Priced roughly fair-to-slightly-rich.
key_drivers: Directional base rate 4 up / 6 down over 10 sourced prints -- statistically indistinguishable from a coin flip (Low confidence)
Conditional run-in pattern (beaten-down into print -> up, run-up into print -> down) is ambiguous here: spot is near the March up-print base but also +13% off the June level
Up-gaps historically fade, down-gaps continue -- argues against chasing a relief rally
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: One genuine structural break in the sample points up: a new CFO guiding his second cycle into a stock -27% YTD with short interest rebuilt is precisely the low-expectations configuration that produced +13.3% in March off a near-identical base.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No sector-cohort base rate sourced empirically; judgemental.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: 10.65% implied is rich against 6.52% median historical. Centred realised expectation 6-9%. Distribution left-skewed: a good print gets a capped rally into pre-CPI de-risking, a guide cut gets the full 10-14%.
key_drivers: Peer prints this season uniformly better-than-feared and bought: Petco +8.8-10.3% on reaffirmed guide, Freshpet +7.6-8% on raised guide, Central Garden & Pet raised EPS guide -- category spend holding, margin is the upside lever, exactly Chewy's story
Bar was already reset in June (guide cut) and stock has since de-rated to 14.6x forward P/E from ~24x a year ago -- residual multiple risk from rates much smaller than it was

Macro overlay hostile but second-order: 10y ~4.80%, ~60% hike odds, oil elevated -- punishes high-beta discretionary but is also a rotation toward the defensive-consumables bucket CHWY has fallen into
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: A second consecutive FY revenue guide-down: Chewy's own pattern is beat-then-cut, and peer beats were margin/cost driven not volume -- Chewy is a volume/active-customer story with demand substrate still soft underneath (IDEXX clinic visits down, Petco says dog demand soft until 2027).
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No verified CHWY-specific ETF/fund flow data; no dealer gamma/skew read, left-skew inferred from historical distribution.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Expect realised absolute move ~6-8% vs 10.65% weekly straddle. Magnitude looks rich; direction not priced in either direction.
key_drivers: Q2 gross margin guided to contract y/y (MAP lapping + fuel surcharge) -- the profit-beat lever that has carried every recent print is pre-neutralised
Consensus revenue $3.32B sits at the very top of management's own $3.30-3.33B guide; consensus actives require ~165k net adds into a category growing only ~2%
No squeeze mechanic: 9.6% float short but 0.46% borrow and 544% availability; insiders net sellers, zero buys in six months
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: FY26 EBITDA bar looks genuinely achievable (FY guide implies H2 margin below H1, no hockey stick needed) -- a merely steady quarter plus a $500M buyback expansion behind an already -25%+ YTD stock squeezes the downside case hard.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No options skew/positioning beyond the given straddle; consensus EPS inconsistent across sources, treated as snippet_only.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Model realised absolute move ~7-9% vs 10.65% implied. Magnitude modestly rich and priced in; genuine uncertainty is direction, not size.
key_drivers: Insider activity is routine 10b5-1/tax-withholding only, no buying anywhere in 2026 -- no cluster, no conviction signal either way; one negative absence: a director who bought openly in 2024 has not bought since despite the stock ~45% lower

Capital-allocation forensics lean positive: previously-unlevered Chewy added a $600M Term Loan B in June and topped up the buyback by $500M in April -- management borrowing to buy its own stock at $19-23

No pre-warning signal since the June cut: CEO who has a track record of telegraphing (May conference warning ahead of the June cut) has made no public appearance or filing since, next appearance is after the print -- an absence consistent with no second cut, though absence is weak evidence
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Class B overhang: 176.5M Class B shares held by a sponsor that has serially sold into strength via marketed secondaries -- a post-earnings relief rally is precisely the condition that unlocks that supply.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No Google Trends/app-rank data; short-interest figures single-sourced with a known factual error elsewhere in the same piece.

synthesis.move_band_note: unsigned magnitude band, right-skewed; the implied move is roughly one standard deviation, not a cap
synthesis.early_prediction: Panel is genuinely split and weak (consensus -8, range -25 to +12, 5 of 7 negative but none beyond Lean-Down strength) on a live guidance binary -- the June sales-guide cut already reset the bar once, and whether a second cut is needed is the swing question; likely a modest, ambiguous move rather than a repeat of the two double-digit historical prints; main caveat is two-sided squeeze/breakdown risk from a rebuilt-but-loose short base plus a large Class B sponsor overhang that could sell into any relief rally.
synthesis.red_team_survival_note: The red-team case (Q2 gross margin pre-guided down, consensus revenue at the top of management's own range, no squeeze mechanic in the float) landed at only -8, near the panel's weakest score, and was matched almost exactly by the base-rate persona's independent -9 -- but two personas (macro/peer read-through +10, forensics +12) read the same setup as a bar already reset by June's cut, pointing to strong peer prints (Petco, Freshpet) and management's own buyback-funded buying as reasons the skeptic case may be stale. The thesis did not survive unanimously: it is contested territory, not a dominant view, which is why the panel lands at No Edge rather than Lean Down.

independence_note: Seven isolated subagents; each received only the Phase-0 anchors (ticker, company, event window/session/date, spot+as-of, event-implied move+source, historical realised moves). None saw the stage 2 dossier, its preliminary direction score, another persona's verdict, or the chair's view.
